symbols.name: DocumentInfoTransformer
symbols.summary: Customizes the OpenAPI document information including title, version, and description.
symbols.remarks: This transformer configures the OpenAPI document's info section with customized title, version, description, and other metadata. It can be configured through dependency injection or use sensible defaults. Key responsibilities: Sets the API titleSets the API versionAdds or updates the API descriptionOptionally adds contact and license informationCan extract version from assembly or configuration
